shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular panel
curved hook-like or arching linear elements
justification: Both are flat panels carved in shallow relief with repeated motifs organised in horizontal registers, and both include arching/hooked curved forms, but that is about as far as it goes. A shows a botanical scheme of stems with palmette-like fans and rosettes arranged vertically along the panel edge, while B shows rows of zigzag/chevron bands and abstract curved hook-and-loop signs with what may be schematic animal or face forms — the vocabularies are quite different.
